intel.title: Community programme priority
intel.lead: Where further review, outreach or referral strengthening may be useful, based on community signals, contextual vulnerability and data confidence.
intel.bannerBody: Synthetic women-and-girls community records. This is a prototype decision-support and programme-prioritisation pattern. It is not a validated epidemiological model, does not diagnose disease and does not estimate prevalence.
intel.suppression: Counts below {{threshold}} are not shown and observation numbers appear only as ranges. This is a prototype privacy pattern, not a reviewed disclosure control; it does not stop every way of working out a hidden number.
intel.notFinding: A programme priority is a prompt for review, outreach or further assessment. It is not a finding about any person or community.
intel.attention: Communities for review or programme attention
intel.needInfo: Communities where more information is needed
intel.referrals: Referrals in this period (women and girls)
intel.tableTitle: Community signals, context and data confidence
intel.tableLead: Ordered with the most programme attention first. Read every priority together with its data confidence.
intel.capped: Held at priority for review because data confidence is low

gis.legendConfidence: Fainter colour means lower data confidence. Grey means more information is needed.
gis.mapNote: Demonstration view of aggregate programme priority on fictional boundaries. It does not show disease or prevalence.
